public_rationale: The records strongly support the ability to reproduce protected material and thus the risk Marcus described. They do not fully settle infringement for the target period under the stated criteria. The Times complaint supplies examples but contested legal allegations. A later Chinese judgment supplies an actual infringement finding, without sufficiently precise timing to establish the capability before this post. Treating plausible infringement as sufficient would produce a more favorable assessment, which is why the interpretation is flagged.
limitations: This is not a finding that generative outputs cannot infringe.
A capability claim does not require typical behavior or frequent infringement.
Copyright outcomes depend on jurisdiction and circumstances.
